result.summary: The home screen is mostly intact; the only notable visual defect is the last restaurant card in the Fastest near you row, whose name is clipped by the screen edge (beyond the intended partial-card carousel behavior).

issues.description: In the Fastest near you carousel, the third restaurant name is cut off mid-word as “Trattoria Piccol” at the right edge. The instruction allows a last item (and its title) to be only partially visible, but the title is truncated as if by overflow rather than simply being a card peeking off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Give card titles enough right padding or allow wrapping/ellipsis inside the card so names remain fully readable even when the card is only partially on screen.
